deployment.description: Deployment-level overrides for the bootstrap provider controller, including replicas, containers, and scheduling settings

manager.description: Controller manager settings of the bootstrap provider, such as feature gates, verbosity and other options

patches.description: Optional CAPI Operator spec.patches list for the bootstrap provider.

config.description: Key-value configuration data stored in the configuration Secret. Only used when configSecret.create is true

configSecret.description: Configuration for the Secret that provides controller configuration variables

create.description: Specifies whether the configuration Secret should be created by this chart

deployment.description: Deployment-level overrides for the controlplane provider controller, including replicas, containers, and scheduling settings

manager.description: Controller manager settings of the controlplane provider, such as feature gates, verbosity and other options

patches.description: Optional CAPI Operator spec.patches list for the controlplane provider.

inPlaceUpdates.description: Cluster API in-place updates settings (experimental). Requires inPlaceUpdates.enabled in the cluster-api provider as well, the release fails if spec.manager.featureGates of the cluster-api CoreProvider lacks the InPlaceUpdates and RuntimeSDK gates (gates set by other means are not recognized)

enabled.description: Enable the InPlaceUpdates feature gate of the controlplane provider. Defaults to global.enableInPlaceUpdates if unset. Explicitly set controlPlane.manager.featureGates take precedence. The extension webhook is deployed whenever the resulting gate is enabled. Disabling removes the webhook, so do it only when no clusters use the InPlace update strategy or are being updated

affinity.description: Affinity of the extension webhook server pods

repository.description: Image repository. Defaults to <global.registry>/capi/k0smotron if global.registry is set, otherwise to quay.io/k0sproject/k0smotron

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the extension webhook server pods

replicas.description: Number of extension webhook server replicas

resources.description: Resources of the extension webhook server container

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the extension webhook server pods
